description: This file defines a custom singly linked list implementation in Kotlin, including operations such as add, remove, size, and get.

classes.name: LinkedList
classes.description: A custom implementation of a singly linked list in Kotlin with methods to add, remove, get size, and retrieve elements by index.

classes.name: Node
classes.description: A private inner class representing a node in the linked list, holding a data String and reference to the next node.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds a new element to the end of the linked list.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes the first occurrence of a specified element from the list, returns true if removal was successful.

methods.name: size
methods.description: Returns the number of elements in the list.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves the element at a specified index, throws IndexOutOfBoundsException if index is invalid.

methods.name: unlink
methods.description: Private helper method to unlink a node from the list, adjusting pointers accordingly.

methods.name: tail
methods.description: Companion object method that returns the last node in the list, given the head node.
